# Vendored Kenney CC0 assets

This directory contains a curated subset of self-contained GLB models from Kenney asset packs for Homeland's baseline visuals.

License: CC0 1.0 (public domain)
Publisher: Kenney
Transfer source: https://github.com/Hidencod/tge-assets

Original pack pages:
- https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads
- https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-suburban
- https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial
- https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
- https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters
- https://kenney.nl/assets/blocky-characters

Kenney states that assets on its asset pages are public-domain/CC0 and may be used in commercial projects without attribution. The transfer source catalog identifies these packs as CC0-1.0.

The selected set intentionally stays small: representative roads, village/CBD buildings, civilian variants, a CISF fallback character, and civilian/CISF vehicles.
